source: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 documentation + RUL literature
key_insights: Engine degradation is non-linear — accelerates near failure
RUL clipping at 125 cycles represents healthy flat region
Rolling windows capture degradation trends better than raw readings
Sensors s6, s10, s16, s18, s19 are constant — no predictive value
Engine-wise split prevents cycle-level data leakage
data_requirements_informed_by_domain: Clip threshold of 125 cycles based on C-MAPSS literature
Grouped split mandatory — engine cycles are time-correlated
